description: Discrete attack-aircraft actions: hold, formation return, or attack one permanent blue-unit slot. A target action fires in range and otherwise flies directly toward that target.

actions.name: RETURN_HOME
actions.description: Return the formation to the carrier for recovery and rearming.

actions.name: ATTACK_TARGET_1
actions.description: Attack permanent blue-unit slot 1. Fire if in range; otherwise fly directly toward it.

actions.name: RETURN_TO_LEADER
actions.description: Follower only: return to this aircraft's formation slot beside the current team leader.
